subject.title: Heartbeat isolated mode: cadence stalls, 'heartbeat last' mislabels exec-events, lightContext stays heavy, heartbeat-state writer appears missing

question: Should this broad heartbeat report remain the canonical tracker for durable heartbeat observability, failure-path event handling, and isolated/lightContext context fixes, or should maintainers split those into narrower issues and close this after linking them?
rationale: Current code proves some remaining defects, but the permanent receipt store, event-ack semantics on failed runs, and context-engine identity behavior cross product/storage/runtime ownership and should not be decided by cleanup automation alone.

options.title: Split and link narrower trackers
options.body: Create or confirm separate canonical issues for durable receipts, failed-run event consumption, and isolated context replay, then close this broad issue only after the links preserve its evidence.

options.title: Keep this as umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical umbrella and require any fix PRs to explicitly state which acceptance criteria they address.

options.title: Scope to docs only
options.body: Declare the runtime receipt/state-file parts out of scope and keep only documentation/status clarification work, accepting that deeper reliability concerns move elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Split and link narrower trackers
recommendation.body: Create or confirm separate canonical issues for durable receipts, failed-run event consumption, and isolated context replay, then close this broad issue only after the links preserve its evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged heartbeat wake/cooldown work makes this the best available routing owner for the product/storage decision.
